data_fields.name: maxMessageIntervalS
data_fields.donor_constant: 5 (one message per 5 s on average, as 1.0 / 5.0 per second)

best_idea: Keep a per-player time-decayed message rate, warn above 0.75 of the allowed band, and mute for 180 s above 1.0, with the mute refusal in the same call that updates the rate.
decision_why: Use the rate band for chat and social requests, not for fight intents (the fight state machine owns attack cadence); add a zero-gap guard the donor lacks and record mutes in the one ledger instead of memory.
acceptance: A server test sends one social message per second for 40 s; the warn note appears once the band is crossed, the message that crosses 1.0 is refused with the remaining mute time, a banned-word message is refused and leaves the rate unchanged, and a 30 s pause makes the next message a fresh rate.
